summary: Automated monitoring probe tokens billed after org merge, provisional negative invoice and auto-hold
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that their synthetic monitoring probes (marked non-billable) were charged on the March 6 provisional invoice after an org merge on March 5. The provisional invoice shows a negative balance that triggered an automated payment hold and temporary service restrictions for some API keys.

Impact:
- NovaChat Labs observed $42.37 in unexpected charges for ~1,200 probe tokens flagged as billable.
- Provisional negative balance (-$42.37) caused automatic billing hold and a limited service state for two subaccount API keys for ~2 hours.
- Customer is concerned about downstream effects on SLAs and has asked for an immediate credit and root cause.

Environment:
- Dedicated account (org id: org-nova-1145) migrated into a consolidated billing parent on 2026-03-05 (merge job id: merge-2026-03-05-7).
- Affected keys are in prod (us-east).

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence:
1) 2026-03-05 03:12 UTC: Billing/merge job ran to remap subaccount org IDs into consolidated parent.
2) 2026-03-05 03:15 - 10:00 UTC: NovaChat synthetic monitors executed probe calls (identified by probe_user_agent and probe_tag=non-billable).
3) 2026-03-06 00:05 UTC: Hourly usage postbacks aggregated and forwarded to billing; some postbacks from probe keys were posted with parent_org_id instead of subaccount_org_id.
4) 2026-03-06 01:30 UTC: Provisional invoice generation applied charges; the probe-specific non-billable tag was not applied to ~1,200 tokens leading to $42.37 billable amount.
5) 2026-03-06 02:05 UTC: Automated billing rule detected negative provisional balance and placed account on hold (auto-hold policy triggered).

Relevant logs / links:
- Slack thread: #support -> https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C02SUPPORT/p1678012345678
- Billing job logs: s3://redwood-ops/billing/merge-2026-03-05-7/logs/merge.log
- Postback samples: postback_ids [pb-99321, pb-99324, pb-99342] (see attached with ticket)
- Provisional invoice id: inv-prov-2026-03-org-nova-1145-03-06

Customer request:
- Immediate reversal/credit for the $42.37 and removal of the billing hold.
- Explanation of root cause and confirmation that synthetic probe traffic will not be charged going forward.
comments: 2026-03-07 10:12 - Aisha Patel (Support): Initial triage done with customer over a call. Collected sample postbacks and provisional invoice. Escalated to Billing Eng (assigned Tomás). Customer contact: Elena Marquez (elena@novachat.com).

2026-03-07 13:40 - Tomás Guerrero (Billing Eng): Confirmed probe tokens appear in usage table with tag 'probe' but their billing_tag column is NULL for ~1,230 rows. Suspect remap job may have stripped the non-billable tag during org id substitution. Added billing/backfill label.

2026-03-07 16:05 - SRE (Lena Huang): Collected merge job output. merge-2026-03-05-7 completed with 0 exit code but shows 4 warnings regarding org_id_remap table TTL; cross-checked with service-discovery. We will run targeted query to verify mapping consistency.

2026-03-08 09:22 - Billing Ops (Priya Desai): Applied temporary $42.37 credit to inv-prov-2026-03-org-nova-1145-03-06 and lifted the provisional hold. Notified customer and lifted API key restriction at 09:28 UTC.
2026-03-08 12:10 - Customer (Elena Marquez): Thanks — hold lifted and services restored. Please advise on long-term fix and backdated billing adjustments if required.
2026-03-09 08:55 - Tomás Guerrero: Running backfill now (billing_recalc job). Expect recalculation to re-tag postbacks and adjust finalized invoice if needed. Will update when job completes.
investigation_notes: Query run: SELECT count(*) FROM usage_postbacks WHERE org_id = 'org-nova-1145' AND billing_tag IS NULL AND probe_tag='non-billable' AND timestamp >= '2026-03-05' AND timestamp < '2026-03-07'; result: 1,237 rows.

Observation: postbacks were accepted by ingestion API with probe_tag preserved, but a downstream remap step that substitutes parent_org_id does a shallow copy and omits billing_tag if present. Code pointer: services/org-mapper/handler.go line ~312 (recent change in PR #4021 added shallow remap).

Hypothesis: org-merge job updated org_id on incoming postbacks using the org-mapper service which returned objects without the billing_tag field for some payload shapes (edge-case where probe_tag existed in headers but not in payload body).

Repro: replayed 10 sample postbacks through a staging replica of the remap service: 3/10 lost billing_tag. Root cause reproducible when header-based probe_tag is present but payload.billing_tag is null.
Related GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4021 (org-mapper shallow copy change, merged 2026-03-02).
Linked internal runbook: Confluence -> Billing -> org-merge-runbook (https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/BILL/pages/Org+Merge+Runbook)
Potential scope: Any org merges performed between 2026-03-02 and 2026-03-06 may have affected probe/non-billable tagging in postbacks.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-08 09:22 - Billing Ops: Temporary credit of $42.37 applied to provisional invoice inv-prov-2026-03-org-nova-1145-03-06 and auto-hold cleared. Customer notified and keys restored.
2026-03-09 14:30 - Engineering: Deployed hotfix to org-mapper service to ensure billing_tag and probe_tag are preserved during remap (patch: org-mapper v1.3.2).

Backfill plan: billing_recalc job run to replay affected postbacks and reclassify the 1,237 probe postbacks as non-billable. Expected delta: -$42.37 on provisional invoice; if invoice already finalized will issue invoice credit.
Monitoring / follow-up: Added metric remap.billing_tag_loss.rate and alert (pager duty) if >0 for 10m. Post-deploy, we ran verification and saw 0 lost tags on test replay.
Customer follow-up: We will issue a formal billing adjustment if the recalculation changes any finalized invoices and send a confirmation email + billing statement to Elena Marquez.
